info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Disbursement Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Disbursement Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific disbursements related to loans. By utilizing this endpoint, stakeholders such as financial institutions and loan processors can retrieve vital data associated with disbursements by specifying their unique identifiers. This functionality supports operations involving loan tracking, financial reporting, and auditing, facilitating a better understanding of disbursement activities. Typical consumers of this API include loan management systems and financial analysts who require accurate and timely disbursement information.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific disbursement for a loan.
get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific disbursement associated with the given loan ID. This endpoint allows developers to access disbursement details for managing loan operations effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a disbursement for a specific loan by specifying the loan ID and the disbursement ID. The structure of the request body is defined in the referenced schema, which outlines all necessary fields and their types.

GetLoanDisbursementByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving disbursement information related to a specific loan.
